page.notes: The line "Unum addo, ex quo mens Allatij perdisci potest" is printed twice, once in the paragraph before "Perdis" and once as its own paragraph; both are transcribed as printed. "dum ita" ends the line with a mark that may be a hyphen or a dash, so it is marked [?]. Italic and roman passages are set from the scan as far as visible; the exact boundaries of "Quid igitur" and "Quid audimus" are uncertain. The word "Aduersa" is printed with u in the middle, which I changed to v as a consonant. "Liberium" and "Liberius" are as printed. The top right number is 555.
